name: The Tegetthoffplatz Hornbeam
access: Free, on a public city square (Tegetthoffplatz)
transport: Tegetthoffplatz tram stop (Line 1), right at the square
verify_notes: Austrian Naturdenkmal ND256544 (Steiermark register), designated 2019-05-03, Katastralgemeinde St. Leonhard, Grundstücksnummer 221/3 (a public square parcel). Species and coordinate come from the official register/Wikipedia's 'Liste der Naturdenkmäler in Graz' (wikitext, one source). Second, independent confirmation: a Wikimedia Commons photo (file 'ID 256544Carpinus betulus 294A5661.jpg', CC BY-SA 4.0, Christian Pirkl) taken 2020-12-26, whose embedded EXIF coordinates (47°04'35.27"N, 15°27'32.85"E) match the register point, captioned 'Hainbuche (Carpinus betulus L.) am Tegetthoffplatz in Graz, St. Leonhard. Im Hintergrund das Seebachergymnasium' -- the school is only the background, the tree itself stands on the public square, not school grounds. No news of removal or storm damage found (searched). No girth or age figure exists in any source checked (register has no measurement field for this entry, unlike some others in the same list); age_estimate left honestly empty per the estimate-or-ask rule, page should invite a reader with a tape measure. Stands about 350m from grz_011 (The Elisabethstrasse Plane), so it extends that walking cluster rather than opening a new one. Access: a named public 'Platz' (square) in central Graz, no gate, no institution between the reader and the trunk.
